name: cost_estimation
description: Estimates the resource cost of a plan: model tokens, wall-clock minutes, disk delta, and number of files touched. Deterministic given plan + declared engine budgets. Used by the scheduler to respect performance budgets and by the operator to approve plans.

inputs.name: engine_budgets
inputs.description: Map engine_id -> performance_budget (declared in each module.json).

outputs.name: cost_report
outputs.description: { tokens_estimated, minutes_min, minutes_max, disk_delta_bytes, files_touched, budget_violations: [{ engine_id, field, declared, needed }] }

error_codes.message: A step would exceed its engine's declared performance_budget.
error_codes.recovery: Surface the violation in budget_violations; do not auto-approve the plan; suggest splitting the step.

error_codes.message: A step's capability has no resolved engine.
error_codes.recovery: Mark cost as unknown for that step; log; continue with the rest.

examples: plan with 4 steps each max_latency=250ms -> minutes_max approx ceil(sum_latencies/60000) + model_time.
